notes.title: Lurk Released!
notes.notes:
Lurk was released today and is available at a discount until March 15th! I hope you enjoy it as much as I enjoyed developing it, and if you encounter any bugs or have questions/comments feel free to send them through my [url=http://www.biodynamicgames.com/contact]website[/url].

- Arman
